findings.title: Spec 001 still says cancellation is not implemented
findings.why: Spec 001 says 'Cancellation (no refund < 24h before start, otherwise full) is NOT implemented yet'. `cancel` now exists in `src/index.ts` and spec 005 describes it as implemented, so spec 001 contradicts the code. The path is a guess, because the glob `specs/001*/spec.md` hid the directory name.

findings.title: 24h literal duplicates the existing DAY_MS constant
findings.why: `DAY_MS` is defined at line 58 as `24 * 60 * 60 * 1000`. The refund check repeats the expression instead of using it.
